data.body: AC amendment (gap G6): Document _CAP_PER_PASS semantics. PINNED: _CAP_PER_PASS is PER-INVARIANT, not global. check_at_most_one and check_dual_identity each track violations_filed independently; they do NOT share a budget. Two invariants × cap=5 = up to 10 bugs per pass. Document this in invariants.py module docstring + KNOWN-ISSUES.md (covered in T5).
